limitations: This audit covers the central raw-native admission boundary, not all 166 domain producers or unpublished author rules.

Derived-only producer parameter units and field-specific supplied policies still require each domain adapter to select audited parent measurements; central raw-native definition checks do not manufacture a missing derived definition.
Physical file hashes and rows establish provenance, not complete tape coverage or strict economic order inside tied timestamps.
Historical source-case reconstruction and family reports must be regenerated by integration after the shared changes; prior report hashes are not evidence for this revision.
verified_behaviors: Native q/tick_size claims must be finite positive and exactly equal the resolved immutable instrument definition; a caller unit cannot replace a missing definition.
Input formation/start/end/window/as_of duplicates must match the object envelope. Canonical native known_at, definition and coverage are supplied by resolution, never copied caller summaries.
Actual parent IDs and deep-copied parent records replace dependency contents, parents maps and parent_ids. Duplicate or foreign dependency identity is rejected; unknown parent clocks remain unknown.
Native row containers, copied candles and raw OHLC/trade/BBO scalar fields are removed before domain adapters. Domain-specific selectors and parameters remain the adapter responsibility.

Native interval outputs intersect trusted resolver coverage, except independently complete retained OHLC membership and explicit literal O003 clock/O112 BBO scopes. Measured tape totals can remain visible while coverage stays unknown.
Unknown consumed instrument-definition availability propagates when output uses tick units; literal complete OHLC does not depend on an unused tick unit.

O003 native clock_verified cannot be supplied by an ordinary Boolean. Verification requires an exact-window source-admitted parent or exact fact from the frozen catalog with actual immutable PDF citation validation. Inference/unknown/conflict does not become a source clock fact.
